subject: Create change plan for replacing YOLOv10n backbone with YOLOv8 backbone
description: Analyze YOLOv10n.yaml and YOLOv8.yaml backbones. Produce a change_plan detailing the minimal edits needed to replace the v10n backbone with v8 backbone while keeping v10n head/neck runnable. Key diffs: SCDown→Conv at backbone layers 5,7; remove PSA layer 10; adjust head 'from' indices for shifted backbone.

todos.content: Resolve all target files: read ultralytics/cfg/models/v10/yolov10n.yaml and ultralytics/cfg/models/v8/yolov8.yaml. Also check if SCDown, PSA, Conv, C2fCIB, v10Detect are importable from ultralytics/nn/modules/__init__.py
todos.activeForm: Resolving target files and module imports

todos.content: Analyze backbone diff: identify every line-level difference between YOLOv10n backbone and YOLOv8 backbone (SCDown→Conv at layers 5,7; PSA layer 10 removal)
Compute head index shifts: trace how head layer indices change when PSA is removed from backbone. Calculate new 'from' references for the Concat that connects to backbone P5 output

Produce change_plan artifact: JSON with fields 'target_file', 'backbone_changes' (list of edits to backbone section), 'head_changes' (list of edits to head section), 'index_shift_explanation', and 'risk_notes'. Each change must specify old_text and new_text
todos.reason: Auto-completed after successful submit of change_plan.
